title: Convert TutorPinResult switches in gate/setup screens from statements to switch expressions per EH-6
why: coding-standards.md EH-6 states closed variant sets must be modeled as sealed + 'switch over it with switch expressions; never add a default:/_ arm.' Both files use switch STATEMENTS (case Pattern: followed by statement blocks) over the sealed TutorPinResult, not the mandated expression form (contrast with tutor_pin_reset_screen.dart's `child: switch (_step) { ... => ..., }`, which does it correctly). Functionally harmless today — Dart's exhaustiveness checker covers statement-form switches too — but it's a textual violation of an explicitly documented, partially-enforced standard, and inconsistent with the sibling file in the same feature.
recommendation: Rewrite both switches as switch expressions (`TutorPinSuccess() => widget.onPinVerified(), ...`), matching tutor_pin_reset_screen.dart's style.
acceptance_criteria: both switches use the `Pattern => ...,` expression form with no default/_ arm
flutter analyze remains clean and existing gate/setup widget tests pass unchanged
